title: Welcome to you! – a mawlid poem
intro: A famous Bosnian mawlid poem welcoming the Prophet (SAW).

learn.html:
Welcome to you, greatest son
of the Arab people and homeland!
Welcome to you, noble one,
of Hashim, of Quraysh!

You who will lift the weak to their feet
and free many peoples from slavery!
Welcome to you, bringer of light,
intercessor and saviour!

When Israfil blows the trumpet,
our souls will hope in you.
You will ease the troubles of the unhappy,
you will reach out your hand to the sinner.
(From the mawlid poem of Safvet-beg Bašagić, English translation)
Muhammad (SAW) – may Allah’s peace be upon him.

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: Muhammad (SAW) said: “The closest to me on the Day of Judgement will be those who sent the most salawat on me.” (Tirmidhi)
